desc: Redraw this backpack turtle as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic turtle proportions, same face, teal shell, green bedroll backpack with straps, light blue skin, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on shell and bedroll, subtle shell shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
